instruments.primary: organiser-score set algebra: |G| from the exact A subset B nesting, per-file credit T_i = score_i*(0.2*S_i + 0.8*|G|), and LP-identified intervals on candidate emission sets
instruments.disqualified: local hide-and-recover simulator -- measured Spearman -0.10 against the reported board, and uniform random beats the champion at matched budget (R4 section 3, knowledge/10 section 5)
instruments.reported_anyway: hide-and-recover is still run because the brief requires the single-view bias comparison; it cannot promote anything

views.band6_note: organiser describes band 6 as a magnetic tilt derivative; measured range 2.95-88.6 identifies it as radiometric total count (IR-52-019/IR-52-034), so it belongs to the surface view

decision_rules: recompute |G| from the A subset B nesting on restored bytes; never copy it
ship the core only if its identified DTI_lo is within 0.02 of the champion's 0.2772 and its mid-interval estimate exceeds it
admit an arm pixel only if its estimated credit density >= 0.064
emit nothing within 200 m of a mapped catalogue pixel
no NaN anywhere; values exactly {0,1}; single-band float32 on the sample grid
abandon the pseudo-label exchange if max|rho| > 0.60 and fall back to the plain two-view rank
publish research-only unless a candidate beats the champion on a validated instrument
